note: Twenty business questions. Each has a metric query for the compiler and a hand-written reference SQL statement that follows the correct route. Reference SQL uses substr() for time grains so it does not share code with the compiler's strftime().

questions.question: What is total revenue?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(line_total) FROM order_items

questions.question: What is revenue by month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7), SUM(i.line_total) FROM order_items i LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: What is revenue by customer region?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(i.line_total) FROM order_items i LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: What is revenue by product category?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(i.line_total) FROM order_items i LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: What is revenue by region and category?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT c.region, p.category, SUM(i.line_total) FROM order_items i LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

questions.question: What is revenue by month for West customers?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7), SUM(i.line_total) FROM order_items i LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.region = ? GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: What is revenue by day for the first week of March?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 10), SUM(i.line_total) FROM order_items i LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= ? AND o.order_date < ? GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How many units were sold by category?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity) FROM order_items i LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How many units were sold by order status?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT o.status, SUM(i.quantity) FROM order_items i LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How many orders are there?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders

questions.question: How many orders are there by status?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How many orders are there by month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7), COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How many orders are there by customer region?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT c.region, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How many distinct orders went out with each carrier?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT s.carrier, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How many customers are there by region?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM customers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How many customers signed up each year?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT substr(signup_date, 1, 4), COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM customers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How much cash was collected by payment method?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT method, SUM(amount) FROM payments GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How much cash was collected by customer region?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(p.amount) FROM payments p LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How many shipments went out each month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT substr(shipped_date, 1, 7), COUNT(*) FROM shipments GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: What is the average list price by category?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT category, AVG(unit_price) FROM products GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
